item.title: Blanche cancels 'anti-weaponization' fund ahead of AG confirmation vote
item.description: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche issued an order late Sunday terminating the $1.8 billion 'anti-weaponization fund' established by President Trump.

item.title: The Essex Files: Trump outlines a strategy for Middle East peace
New California law broadens DNA tools for missing persons cases
item.description: Governor Newsom signed a law expanding California's Missing Persons DNA Program to help identify living and deceased individuals across many cases.

item.title: Todd Blanche nears confirmation after ending $1.8B fund
item.description: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche moved closer to confirmation after complying with demands to cancel a settlement deal linked to President Trump.
